examples.en: The theory of Baudrillard has criticized a series of aesthetic categories.
examples.zh: 鲍德·里亚的思想批判了近代美学的一系列概念。

examples.en: And if Baudrillard can't be understood, then he can't be misunderstood, either.
examples.zh: 如果鲍德·里亚不能被理解，那他就不会被误解。

examples.en: But while you have Rossi at one end, at the other extreme of your interests you have Baudrillard.
examples.zh: 但是你兴趣的一端是罗西，而另一个极端却是鲍德·里亚。
